title: automate-changelog-and-onboard-arion-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Patel
description:
Context: Onboard the new Arion-13B v1.0 model into the model registry and enable automated changelog/release note generation for model metadata and performance profile updates. Motivation: Arion has been validated by research and private perf runs; making it available in the registry with curated perf profiles and ensuring automated changelog entries reduces manual work and avoids release-note drift. This PR does three things: 1) Adds model metadata and performance profiles for arion-13b v1.0 (GPU and quantized variants). 2) Adds validation CI that checks perf profile schema, required fields, and a smoke inference benchmark for common sequence lengths. 3) Extends the changelog-generator to pick up model registry metadata updates and emit draft release notes with performance delta summaries. Description of changes: - model-registry/models/arion-13b/v1/metadata.yaml: new model entry including name, architecture, tokenizer_hint, supported_variants, default_checkpoint, license, and source_link. - model-registry/models/arion-13b/v1/perf/profiles.json: perf profiles for rtx-a6000 (fp16), a100-80g (bf16), and a quantized int8 variant; includes p50/p90 latencies and tokens/sec for 8/16/32 seq. - tools/changelog-generator/registry-watcher.py: hook to detect changes to model metadata/perf profiles and synthesize changelog sections. - ci/validate-perf-profiles.yml: new workflow (schema/lint + perf-smoke job using a small local perf harness) that runs on PRs touching model metadata. - docs/model-registry/onboarding.md: short onboarding checklist and expected metadata fields. - tests/test_perf_profile_validation.py: unit tests for schema validation and example regression detection thresholds. Migration notes: The changelog generator looks for a "perf_delta" key between previous and new profile snapshots; when not available it emits a "manual review required" note. Rollout: Draft changelog generation is opt-in for now via a new label `changelog/draft` applied to PRs; maintainers can accept generated notes or edit before merging. Checklist:
- [x] Add metadata.yaml for arion-13b v1.0
- [x] Add perf profiles for target hardware and quantized variant
- [x] Add CI validation workflow and unit tests
- [x] Integrate changelog-generator hook and wire to registry watcher
- [x] Update onboarding docs and examples
Related: ENG-2345 (model onboarding), PM-678 (launch coordination).
